(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The method of sending data to a client computer, the method comprising: providing a first server computer; providing a second server computer that is a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature; and enabling the client computer to select the hyperlink, the method further comprising subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request.

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: The system for sending data to a client computer, the system comprising: a first server computer; a second server computer that is a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature; and circuitry for enabling the client computer to select the hyperlink, the system further comprising circuitry for generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request.

(Currently Amended) Claim 27: The computer program product for sending data to a client computer, the computer program product comprising: program code for providing a second server computer that is a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature; program code for enabling the client computer to select the hyperlink; and program code for subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request.
